name: Li Qian
current_role: Chairman, Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. (STAR Market: 688621)
profile: Li Qian (利虔) is chairman and largest shareholder (~38%) of Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research, a CRO providing preclinical and clinical drug R&D services, which he has chaired since 2009. He also chairs Beijing Baiao Pharmaceuticals and is founder/executive director of Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology. Sun-Novo reported 2025 revenue of about RMB 1.22bn.
interesting_fact: Sun-Novo describes itself as moving from a pure CRO 'service provider' toward an innovation-driven 'partner' with its own self-developed drugs; 2025 revenue rose 12.9% to RMB 1.218bn and net profit 10.5% to RMB 196m.
deep_cut_fact: Besides Sun-Novo, he founded Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology Holdings (exec director since Jan 2016) and has been a non-executive director of Eastenova (Chengdu) Biotechnology since 2025; he studied at Peking University Health Science Center.
notes: Personally hosts investor meetings (e.g. March 2026) alongside IR director Guo Xinchi (郭心驰) and board secretary Wei Liping (魏丽萍); IR route is via SSE E-Interaction / company IR hotline. Company site sun-novo.com was unreachable during research.

name: Sheng Junhai
profile: Listed by Hurun (2006-2017) with wealth from Romon (罗蒙), a Ningbo (Fenghua) menswear/suit maker founded in 1978. No source found during this task naming Sheng Junhai (盛军海) at Romon; Romon's official site names Sheng Jingsheng (盛静生) as group chairman.
notes: Could not confirm identity or current role. Possibly a Hurun name variant or family member of chairman Sheng Jingsheng (unverified). Romon group general contact published on romon.com: romon@romon.com, hotline 0574-88888888 (company, not personal).

name: Zhu Mingyue
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, ZBJ (Zhubajie / 猪八戒网), Chongqing
profile: Zhu Mingyue (朱明跃) founded ZBJ.com in Chongqing in 2006, an online marketplace for outsourced services that began with crowdsourced logo design and became a unicorn after a RMB 2.6bn investment in 2015. A former Chongqing Evening News reporter, he is also a National People's Congress deputy and still leads the company as founder and CEO.
interesting_fact: In Feb 2020, with ZBJ's 3,000+ staff and over RMB 60m monthly fixed costs, he told employees 'Unless self-rescue, the cash flow will break in three months' and ran an all-employee online push; he later said post-resumption indicators exceeded expectations.
deep_cut_fact: Before tech he was a primary-school teacher for 3 years and a reporter for 8; while still at Chongqing Evening News he paid RMB 500 to have a website built to understand the internet, then quit at 32 to found ZBJ.
notes: Active NPC deputy who comments publicly on SME and gig-worker policy (e.g. Beijing News, Mar 2023). No published press email found; zbj.com lists only a complaints address. Best route likely via ZBJ corporate PR.
